_doc: Classes (docs/design/06-playbooks.md): Apocalypse World's playbooks on UWNH/Inindo mechanics. attributes total about 180 for protagonists; growth splits level-up points (docs/design/04-characters.md). Ability effects: 'mods' are battle stat modifiers, 'battle' special rules or actions, 'rig' road-war modifiers, 'gang' gang-war modifiers, 'map' everything outside battle (applied by later milestones).

abilities.name: Combat driver
abilities.text: Your rig gets +10 Handling, and its guns +15 hit chance, while you drive it

abilities.name: Weather eye
abilities.text: Forecast weather 2 days ahead. Fog and snow slow you 50% less

abilities.name: Eye on the door
abilities.text: Fleeing any battle gets +30%. Once per battle, if your Speed is at least the enemy's, it simply works

abilities.name: Daredevil
abilities.text: When you drive straight into contact range, +3 Armor and +25% Ram damage that turn

abilities.name: Reputation
abilities.text: Explorer Renown gains +25%. Recruit chance +10 in holds that know your name

abilities.name: Collector
abilities.text: Own up to 2 more personal cars, each with its own hood ornament

abilities.name: My other car is a tank
abilities.text: A battle vehicle: 2 extra gun mounts, Armor +3, Durability +40

abilities.name: Pack alpha
abilities.text: Your gang gets +15 training. Bids for its leadership are answered with a Hard check at +20

abilities.name: Fucking thieves
abilities.text: Once per hold visit, find a wanted item in the gang's stash: chance 40 + Sharp / 2

abilities.name: Nomadic
abilities.text: The gang needs 25% less chow and water, and moves off-road at full speed

abilities.name: Well-armed
abilities.text: Gang arms +20. Bought weaponry counts double for arms

abilities.name: Self-sufficient
abilities.text: Raids also yield chow and fuel. Pay can be skipped for one month a year without loss

abilities.name: Well-disciplined
abilities.text: Gang gains the well-disciplined tag

abilities.name: A holding of your own
abilities.text: Take a hold by gang war and make it your seat, with its own Wealth

abilities.name: Wealth
abilities.text: Each month the hold yields 2 + hold size + Trade level / 4 barter if its wants are met

abilities.name: Leadership
abilities.text: Leading your gang, your leader modifier is 1.15, and it breaks only below 20 morale

abilities.name: Caravans
abilities.text: Send 1 standing caravan, +1 for every 4 Trade levels

abilities.name: Investment
abilities.text: Your investment moves Lean 25% further

abilities.name: Armory
abilities.text: Your hold's gang arms +20

abilities.name: Walls
abilities.text: Your hold's walls +1 (to a maximum of 2)

abilities.name: Hardholder of the Quiet
abilities.text: Audience with any faction hardholder whatever your Renown. Holds leaning to you send tribute

abilities.name: Fortunes
abilities.text: Each month, followers yield 1 + followers / 10 barter if devotion is 50 or more

abilities.name: Seeing souls
abilities.text: See an NPC's want and loyalty on sight. +15% on Hot checks against people you've seen

abilities.name: Charismatic
abilities.text: Recruit chance +15. Faith Lean +25%

abilities.name: Frenzy
abilities.text: A crowd or a gang acts as you say: +30 morale to your side, or -30 to theirs

abilities.name: Fucking wacknut
abilities.text: +10 Weird in the In, and Hum exposure gains -30%

abilities.name: Divine protection
abilities.text: +5 Defense, and +10 against Hum damage

abilities.name: Speak to the Choir
abilities.text: Talk to cantors and the Opened in battle; a success makes them stand still for 2 turns

abilities.name: Things speak
abilities.text: Examining salvage tells you its history. Salvage and charts are worth +20%

abilities.name: Spooky intense
abilities.text: Talk in battle gets +20. Enemies with low morale may flee from you

abilities.name: Oftener right
abilities.text: When an officer makes a check on your advice, +10

abilities.name: Bonefeel
abilities.text: Scouting +15%. You're never surprised by an ambush: your party always acts first

abilities.name: Reality's fraying edge
abilities.text: +5 Defense, and +5 more against Hum damage

abilities.name: Deep insights
abilities.text: Projects take 25% less time. Disciplines cost 20% less Grit

abilities.name: The jammer
abilities.text: Begin the Static jammer project

abilities.name: Leave no one behind
abilities.text: Moving to a downed ally gives +2 move that turn and stabilises them

abilities.name: Eager to know
abilities.text: Ask an NPC for advice. Following it gives +20 on the check; ignoring it and failing gives double XP

abilities.name: Inspiring
abilities.text: Allies adjacent to you get +10 accuracy. Officers earn +20% XP

abilities.name: Medlab
abilities.text: Resting at the stasis facility heals the party fully in 3 days

abilities.name: Release
abilities.text: Once per battle, an all-out attack at double damage, after which your Defense is 0 until your next turn

abilities.name: Combat veteran
abilities.text: +10 accuracy with firearms and +2 Speed

abilities.name: Stasis armory
abilities.text: A golden-age rifle and armour from the vault

abilities.name: Angel kit
abilities.text: In battle: heal an adjacent ally 15 + Medicine rank x 5 (Grit 6)

abilities.name: Healing touch
abilities.text: Revive a downed ally at 25% HP (Grit 15)

abilities.name: Dangerous & sexy
abilities.text: +15% on Hot checks in hold scenes

abilities.name: Ice cold
abilities.text: +10 accuracy, and +10 Speed in the first round

abilities.name: Merciless
abilities.text: Critical chance doubled

abilities.name: NOT TO BE FUCKED WITH
abilities.text: Counts as 10 troops in a gang war

abilities.name: Battle-hardened
abilities.text: +10 Health and ignores the frightened status

abilities.name: Deep brain scan
abilities.text: Read a person: see their want and one secret

abilities.name: Direct-brain whisper
abilities.text: Stun one enemy for a turn (Grit 10). Non-sexual in this game
